name: queryHospitalConfig
shortDescription: Retrieves specific hospital configuration settings such as operating hours or policies.
description:
Overview

This function retrieves system-wide configuration settings for the hospital, such as operating hours, holiday schedules, or general policies, as stored in the HospitalConfig entity.

Intended use

Called by various UI components (patient, doctor, admin) to display relevant hospital information. Parameters can include settingName or category to retrieve specific settings or groups of settings.

Logic

  1. Validate input parameters (e.g., settingName or category).
  2. Query the HospitalConfig entity using ctx.data.query, filtering by settingName or category as provided.
  3. Return the matching configuration settings.

Entities

  • HospitalConfig
